aboutTitle: A small place for voluntary giving
about: JustGive is a personal contribution website built around one simple idea: people should be free to give when they wish, without pressure. Contributions are received by the website owner personally. There is no product, subscription, membership, investment, prize, or promised return. You receive a payment confirmation and a thank-you—not a purchased service or reward.
privacyAbusePrevention: To limit repeat appreciations, reports, and abuse, the server uses a keyed one-way hash of the network address and browser user-agent. Raw addresses are not stored. These hashes remain only while their associated message exists.
